Smooth numeric variables within panel IDs

panel_smooth.Rd

Smooth numeric variables within panel IDs

Usage

panel_smooth(
  data,
  vars,
  window = 3,
  weights = c("equal", "half", "decay"),
  time = "TAX_YEAR",
  id = "EIN2",
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A panel data frame.

vars

Numeric fields to smooth.

window

Odd rolling-window width.

weights

"equal", "half", or "decay".

time

Panel-time column.

id

Panel-ID column.

verbose

Print progress.

Value

Input rows in original order with selected fields smoothed.
